subject: tr-info
title: (R)TR.INFO. -----ACC.DY.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-14 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — France/Italy/Northern Europe/Japan) accompanying Braxton's pivot from French infrastructure to French historical contribution: 'France has long been involved in creative music throughout its history. It was in France that the activity of Django Reinhardt was to solidify.' (R)TR-INFO (the reality of trans-information) is crossed with ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics): the question is what trans-information produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with accelerated-dynamics — the (R) prefix marking that real transfer is what produces accelerated-dynamics in the French scene. ACC-DY itself sits at the upper-center, at the end of the main line. RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) branches from the main line to the upper-right margin; LK-IMP (linkage implications) branches from RT-INT-TR, and the line joining IST-PT (isolated particulars) above and CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) below crosses the RT-INT-TR line. EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) drops from the main line to the lower-left; INFO-AF-B (information-affinity basis) branches from EXP-DYM to the lower-right, AF-DY (affinity dynamics) branches from INFO-AF-B, and PART (participation) branches from AF-DY. Structural argument: trans-information-as-real crossed with accelerated-dynamics opens two side chains, reality-initiative-traits above and expansion-dynamics below.
